hero.subtitle: VoltDesk AI unifies support, HR, IT assets, and facilities under one intelligent platform that classifies, predicts, and acts — automatically.

features.sectionSubtitle: One platform. Every team. Full AI.

items.title: Smart Ticket Engine
items.description: Auto-classify, prioritize, and route tickets in under 3 seconds with GPT-4o.

items.title: AI Agent Orchestrator
items.description: Let AI resolve routine tickets automatically with full audit trail and human approval.

items.title: Predictive SLA Engine
items.description: Know which tickets will breach SLA before they do. Act before the deadline.

items.title: HR Operations Hub
items.description: AI-generated onboarding plans, leave request workflows, and sentiment trending across your workforce.

items.title: IT Asset Management
items.description: Track inventory, assign equipment, and catch at-risk assets before they become incidents with AI risk scoring.

items.title: Executive Intelligence & Reports
items.description: Automated weekly reports in plain language — KPIs, bottlenecks, and recommendations generated by GPT-4o every Monday.

items.title: Volt Copilot
items.description: Ask about your tickets, leave requests, or assets in plain language, and generate reports in PDF, Excel, or CSV on demand. One assistant for managers, agents, and employees alike.

items.title: Enterprise Compliance
items.description: SOC 2-ready audit logs, GDPR right to forget, and data retention policies built in.

explainability.subtitle: Every decision is transparent, auditable, and reversible. No black boxes. Ever.

items.title: XAI Panel
items.desc: See exactly why the AI classified each ticket — signal by signal. Full transparency on every decision.

items.title: Confidence Score
items.desc: Red-flag when AI is uncertain. Always know when to review manually before executing.

items.title: Full Audit Log
items.desc: Every prompt, token count, cost, and latency tracked and exportable. SOC 2 ready.

items.title: Full audit trail on every decision
items.description: Every AI classification, agent action, and data access is logged with model, prompt, and confidence score — exportable for compliance review.

items.title: Multi-provider AI, no lock-in
items.description: GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet, and Gemini Flash route automatically per workspace settings, with fallback chains if one provider fails.

items.title: Built for multi-tenant isolation
items.description: Workspace-scoped data at the database level, verified in the test suite — one tenant can never see another's records.

enterprise.title: Built for organizations, not individual seats
enterprise.subtitle: Every workspace is custom-deployed and configured for your departments, compliance requirements, and AI provider preferences. Talk to us about your organization.

techStack.title: Built on technology you trust
techStack.subtitle: Open standards. No vendor lock-in. Enterprise-grade reliability.

cta.subtitle1: VoltDesk AI gives your team the intelligence layer
cta.subtitle2: to classify, predict, and act — automatically.

footer.tagline: AI-native helpdesk that classifies, predicts, and acts. Built for teams that can't afford to slow down.
